bodega_packages_freebsd.query: SELECT 'freebsd' AS ecosystem, name, version, '' AS path FROM bodega_pkg_packages UNION ALL SELECT 'pypi', name, version, path FROM python_packages WHERE directory IN ('/opt/a', '/opt/b') UNION ALL SELECT 'npm', name, version, path FROM npm_packages WHERE directory IN ('/srv/app');

bodega_packages_linux.query: SELECT 'apt' AS ecosystem, name, version, '' AS path FROM deb_packages WHERE status = 'install ok installed' UNION ALL SELECT 'rpm', name, version || '-' || release, '' FROM rpm_packages UNION ALL SELECT 'pypi', name, version, path FROM python_packages WHERE directory IN ('/opt/a', '/opt/b') UNION ALL SELECT 'npm', name, version, path FROM npm_packages WHERE directory IN ('/srv/app');

bodega_packages_freebsd.query: SELECT 'freebsd' AS ecosystem, name, version, '' AS path FROM bodega_pkg_packages;
